name: strategy-red-team
tagline_zh: 别等现实打脸，先自己拆台。针对PRD、路线图或策略，攻击承重假设，按影响×概率×测试成本排序。
tagline_en: Red-team your PRD or strategy before reality does. Attack key assumptions, rank risks by impact × likelihood ×.
desc_en: Red-team a PRD, roadmap, or strategy by attacking its load-bearing assumptions before reality does. Steelmans then attacks each claim, ranks failure modes by impact × likelihood × cheapness-to-test, and returns the cheapest test and kill criteria for each. Use when stress-testing a plan, pressure-testing a strategy, challenging assumptions, or preparing a doc for executive review.
why_zh: 同类工具只列风险清单，它却把每条假设变成可证伪的测试，并给出淘汰线，让决策不再靠感觉。
why_en: Unlike generic risk checklists, it turns each assumption into a falsifiable test with kill criteria, making decisions.
